title: Viwakilishi Viashiria (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses the demonstrative alone in the place of the noun, choosing it by the noun's class, number and distance.
representations: sentence strips with the noun removed

board.do: Kitabu hiki ni changu -> ___ ni changu.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Hiki ni changu" and two more.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "___ ni mti wa mwembe." Kwa nini "Hii" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiwakilishi kiashiria hufuata ngeli ya kitu kinachoonyeshwa: mti, huu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "___ ni vitabu vya shule." Kwa nini "Hiki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitu kimoja: hiki. Vitu vingi: hivi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi yenye kiwakilishi kiashiria (kinasimama peke yake)." Kwa nini "Kitabu hiki ni kizuri." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiwakilishi husimama mahali pa nomino. Kikifuata nomino, ni kivumishi.
Kitu kilicho mbali huonyeshwa kwa yule, ule, kile.
